title: SendGrid ignores the subject you pass when sending with a dynamic template
symptoms: Email arrives with the template's subject, not the one in the request
Subject is blank when the template version has no subject and only data is passed
Top-level subject works without templateId and breaks with it
cause: A dynamic template version that defines a subject overrides any subject set at message or personalization level. To vary it per send, the template subject must itself be a Handlebars expression fed from dynamic_template_data.
fix: Set the template version subject to {{{subject}}} and pass subject inside dynamic_template_data.
apply: { templateId: 'd-xxxxxxxx', dynamicTemplateData: { subject: 'Your order shipped', name: 'Ana' } }  // template subject field: {{{subject}}}
affected: SendGrid v3 Mail Send with dynamic templates (d- ids), as of 2026-10
